title: Reporting.
bodyText: The department shall report biennially to the legislature on actions taken, problems encountered, and legislative actions that may be needed to further implement the intent of this part.
bodyHtml: [§201-65]  Reporting.  The department shall report biennially to the legislature on actions taken, problems encountered, and legislative actions that may be needed to further implement the intent of this part. [L 1985, c 237, pt of §4; am L 1987, c 87, pt of §1]
